content.text:
I've improved your HTML template with several meaningful enhancements:

**Accessibility:**
- Added skip-to-main-content link for keyboard users
- Added visible focus indicators for keyboard navigation
- Changed generic `<section>` to semantic `<article>` elements
- Added proper focus-visible styles for buttons and links

**SEO & Metadata:**
- Added Open Graph meta tags for social sharing
- Added theme-color meta tag
- Added JSON-LD structured data (schema.org)

**Functionality:**
- Added a call-to-action button with hover effects
- Added a feature list with bullet points
- Added footer links (Privacy Policy, Terms of Service)
- Improved button styling with smooth transitions and active states

**Responsive Design:**
- Added media queries for mobile devices
- Adjusted font sizes and spacing for smaller screens

**UX Improvements:**
- Better visual feedback on interactive elements
- Consistent focus styling across all interactive elements

The template is now more accessible, SEO-friendly, and provides better user experience while maintaining clean, well-structured code.
